about: Shot list for the user manual's figures (public/manual.html). Each entry is one <figure>: the page expects the image at public/<file> (WebP). Until a file exists the page shows a placeholder. Take every shot from the REAL app signed in to a SEPARATE demo database (never the dev DB tcs_erp, never a real person's name in demo data). 'route' is the app's hash route; 'state' says what to open/click; 'viewport' the browser size; 'crop' which part of the screen to keep; 'demoData' the records the demo DB must contain. 'designRef' points at the REDESIGN canvas board the figure was planned from (board px, 1440 wide: crop starts at y, height h) — use it for framing only; where the board and the real app differ, shoot the real app. — SHOT 2026-10-01: all 94 images were taken from the real app (standalone server on :3200) against the demo database tcs_erp_demo, seeded by scripts/seed-demo.mjs (demo login admin / Demo@2026; every demo user shares that password). Where the real app differed from the plan, the entry below carries a "shotNote" saying what was actually shot.
